info.title: Mantua hedging
info.description: Predefined hedge-strategy templates as concrete quote-ready legs — arms nothing. x402-priced service. Unpaid requests receive 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED with both rails in one accepts array: Circle Gateway nanopayments and vanilla exact x402 on eip155:8453 (Base Mainnet).

servers.description: Mantua API root — prepend the deployment origin.

get.summary: Predefined hedge-strategy templates as concrete quote-ready legs — arms nothing
get.description: Renders the predefined hedge-strategy templates as concrete advisory legs for one market, sized from the market's current price. Advisory by construction: Mantua's strategy store and execution engine stay internal — every leg is quotable through the paid trading services, never executable through this one.

parameters.name: providerEventId
parameters.description: Provider event id of the game to hedge.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Which side the caller holds — the plans hedge the held side.

parameters.name: exposureUsd
parameters.description: The exposure to hedge, in USD — legs are sized against it.

200.description: The advisory hedge plans with concrete, quote-ready legs

assumedHomePriceBps.description: The market price the leg sizes assume; null when none was available.

quoteHowTo.description: How to turn a leg into a paid quote through the trading services.

body.description: The TradeRequest shape with placeholders filled from a leg.

402.description: Payment required — see PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. The header lists both rails in one accepts array: Circle Gateway nanopayments (gasless, batch-settled) and vanilla exact x402 on eip155:8453.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64url JSON carrying the accepts[] payment requirements for both rails.

400.description: Invalid hedging request (BAD_REQUEST) — e.g. exposureUsd missing or out of range.

404.description: Unknown game — no market context exists for this providerEventId (NOT_FOUND).

503.description: Service dark by configuration (X402_SERVICE_DISABLED) or the depth read failed (UNAVAILABLE).

HedgePlan.description: One predefined hedge-strategy template rendered for the query.

mirrors.description: The internal B9 vocabulary this template mirrors.

quotable.description: False when no assumed price was available and legs carry sizes in USDC only.

HedgeLeg.description: One advisory leg — quotable through the paid trading services.

outcomeIndex.description: 0 = home market, 1 = away market — whose YES the leg trades.

amountUsd.description: Advisory size in USDC — always present.

amountRaw.description: Input size in raw units (6 dp) at the assumed price; absent when no price was available.

triggerBps.description: Fire when the HOME YES probability reaches this (bps); null = act now.
